description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM with 64 and 128 parameters, and two variants of SepLLM with 64 parameters that include H and H/T modifications. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of one order of magnitude. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", is linear and spans from 95% to 100%. The "Vanilla" model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, remaining constant at 100% across the entire range. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model is shown as an orange line with circle markers, starting at approximately 98.2% and rising to a peak of 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model is depicted by a blue line with cross markers, beginning at 97% and increasing to 100% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then remaining relatively stable. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model is a green line with diamond markers, starting at 97.5% and rising to 100% at 4e8 TFLOPs, then fluctuating slightly. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model is a red line with circle markers, starting at 94.5% and increasing to a peak of 99.2% at 2e8 TFLOPs, then gradually rising to 99.1% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
